title: The Void Within
hook: Your body is almost entirely empty
script: Your body is nearly all empty space. Atoms are mostly void. If emptied, humanity fits in a sugar cube. That's the space inside every human. But that's not the strange part. Atoms are almost entirely empty space; if you removed it all, the entire human race would fit inside a single sugar cube. This void is what makes life possible. It's what allows atoms to exist. The empty space is what makes us, us. The void within is what makes life worth living. Now, imagine this void in every sugar cube. Save this to remember the void inside a single sugar cube.
